name: Rudorufu
source:
Likes: Grapes, dishes made from Culue, baths
Dislikes: Heroes and raw onions (except grated onions)

The young manager of Grapes Inn.
Thanks to an incident in his past, he despises Heroes and run his inn with a strict "Zero Heroes" policy. However, he is forced to hire an unknown hero due to a strange twist of fate. Rudolf can be sarcastic and sometimes even antagonistic, but he gives it his all to take care of those around him. for some strange reason, he can't stop sneezing whenever spring rolls around.
